prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1466; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Before we begin, do you consent to this conversation being recorded?

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Please state the location where the accident occurred.

A: It was on a main road in Sugar Land, Texas, near a shopping center entrance. I was stopped at a red light in the right lane.

Q: What were you doing just before the impact?

A: I was waiting for the light to change. I had my foot on the brake and I was fully stopped.

Q: Tell me what happened next.

A: I felt a hard jolt from behind. My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. The other driver's vehicle hit the rear of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I saw it in my mirror for a second, but it was going too fast to stop in time.

Q: Did you get out of your vehicle at the scene?

A: Yes, I got out to check on the other driver. Both of us were okay, and we exchanged information.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes, I have stiffness in my neck, and turning my head to the left hurts. I also get headaches sometimes in the afternoon.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I took two days off to rest, and I have been working on a limited schedule since then.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to this statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I will provide the urgent care records and any physical therapy bills as I receive them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
